imtihonlar.qiymat: O'zbekistondan: shahodatnoma (o'rtacha 4.5+, asosiy fanlardan 4) va tan olingan foundation dasturi; ingliz tili: IELTS 6.0 (har bo'lim 5.5) yoki TOEFL iBT 79
imtihonlar.manba_iborasi: Complete the Diploma of Specialised Secondary Education (Shahodatnoma) with an overall average of 4.5 or above (and grades of 4 in key subjects) and recognised foundation programme.

min_ielts.manba_iborasi: an IELTS score of at least 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each component

xalqaro_yordam_turi.qiymat: Xalqaro talabalarga stipendiyalar mavjud, lekin cheklangan va tanlov asosida
xalqaro_yordam_turi.manba_iborasi: All scholarships are subject to availability, visa requirements, meeting specific criteria and competitive application.
